Name: Jaw
Description: Will create jaw rig (v002, dynamic pivot)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Jaw for local face rigs (BodyJaw local geo), or world space with GameMode.
  Jaw_Ctrl rotates and translates the jaw, UpperFollow / UpperLipBreak / SideBreaks drive the upper lip pivot like v001.
  Dynamic pivot: the JawPivot guide sets where the jaw rotates, <name>Pivot_Ctrl (JawPivot_Ctrl) moves it in the scene (show it with Jaw_Ctrl.PivotCtrl).
  <name>Follow_Null (JawFollow_Null, under Jaw_Ctrl) is what other blocks should follow: Lips v003 finds it from SetJaw = Jaw_Ctrl, set Teeth / Tongue SetParent to JawFollow_Null (constraints on Jaw_Ctrl jump when the pivot moves).

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build. Build it before the Lips block.

Fields:
- SetParent: node the jaw ctrl follows (e.g. Skull_Lwr_Ctrl, Head_Ctrl). new_locator makes a placeholder.
- SetAttrsPosition: node that gets the Jaw_Vis attrs (e.g. Vis_Ctrl). new_locator makes a placeholder.
- CtrlType: Jaw_Ctrl shape (circleY, circleX, circleZ, square).
- CtrlSize: ctrl size (default 4).
- GameMode: off = local rig, Jaw_Bnd / JawUpperLipPivot_Bnd only get the jaw ctrl motion (BodyJaw layer). On = the rig follows SetParent in world space.

Tips:
- Same names as the MouthGames jaw: name this block Mouth_Jaw and the Lips block Mouth (Mouth_Jaw_Ctrl, Mouth_JawPivot_Ctrl, Mouth_JawFollow_Null, Mouth_Jaw_Bnd), so animation transfers between the local and the game rigs. The ctrl is aimed at the lips like MouthGames.
- Jaw v001 blocks have no JawPivot guide, the pivot then starts on the Jaw guide. Create a new block to get the guide.
